headline_line: SVP Engineering | Governed Runtime Reliability | Hyperscaler Alliance Co-Sell | Enterprise Portfolio Leadership

summary.text: An engineering executive leads governed agentic AI platform architecture across regulated enterprise delivery environments. The platform enforces policy-gated agent execution so autonomous workflows stay bounded within approved operating limits. Software dependency graph intelligence enables accelerated legacy-system analysis, exposes architecture dependency chains, and improves transformation visibility across enterprise complexity. In parallel, human override and escalation paths pair with runtime proof-bundle lineage, giving every agent action a traceable governance record. The same platform discipline shows up in regulated modernization work, where embedded release automation and security scanning reduced production risk without slowing delivery velocity. Platform productization leadership converted that governed foundation into $22M in IP-led revenue while scaling engineering teams, positioning applied AI leadership for complex, regulated enterprise adoption ahead.
